name: GGToor, Inc.
summary: Operating as a development-stage company, GGTOOR Inc. primarily engages in the global eSports industry. It also manages GGToor.com, an online portal dedicated to gaming. Furthermore, the company is involved in establishing complexes for youth sports and family entertainment. Originally incorporated in 2009, GGTOOR Inc. is based in Thomasville, Georgia. The organization previously operated as Sports Venues of Florida, Inc. before officially changing its name to GGTOOR Inc. in June 2021.
